Name: Builder's List
Author: bmarquismarkail
Description:
Provides the User with a list of items to find while on your adventure!

LeftCtrl + LeftClick on an item on your crafting or cooking menu to put a list of ingredients on the left-hand side!
LeftCtrl + E to hide/show the list.
Click on the List when there's enough ingredients to craft an item to craft the item (Not implemented for cooking items)
